evidence.title: 3.2V 184Ah Blade Battery LiFePO4 Prismatic battery cells
evidence.summary: Product title and description explicitly identify it as a 'LiFePO4 Prismatic battery cells' (Blade Battery), which corresponds to a hard-shell battery.

feature_match_table.claim_feature: 电池本体，所述电池本体构造为长方体形，所述电池本体具有长度L、宽度H和和厚度D，所述电池本体的长度L大于宽度H，所述电池本体的宽度H大于厚度D，其中，
feature_match_table.reasoning: 公开证据 E7 提供了产品的详细尺寸参数 '21.7*118.3*574.6 mm'。结合刀片电池的行业常识，该尺寸排列为厚度(D)×宽度(H)×长度(L)，即 D=21.7mm, H=118.3mm, L=574.6mm。计算可知 L (574.6) > H (118.3) > D (21.7)，完全满足长方体形且长度大于宽度、宽度大于厚度的特征。

evidence.title: 3.2V 184Ah Blade Battery LiFePO4 Prismatic battery cells
evidence.summary: Dimension listed as 21.7*118.3*574.6 mm. Interpreting as Thickness*Width*Length, L>H>D is satisfied.

feature_match_table.claim_feature: 所述电池本体的厚度D与所述电池本体的体积V满足：D/V= 0.0000065 mm ﹣2 ~0.00002mm ﹣2 ；
feature_match_table.reasoning: 基于 E7 提供的尺寸 D=21.7mm, H=118.3mm, L=574.6mm，计算电池本体体积 V = L×H×D = 574.6 × 118.3 × 21.7 = 1,474,382.66 mm³。计算厚度与体积之比 D/V = 21.7 / 1,474,382.66 ≈ 0.0000147 mm⁻²。该值落在权利要求限定的 0.0000065 mm⁻² ~ 0.00002 mm⁻² 范围内，明确满足该特征。
